steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: A scatter graph plots two variables against each other to show the relationship between them. Each point represents one data item.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What type of correlation would you expect between hours of sleep and tiredness? | A line of best fit has equation y = 3x + 5. Predict y when x = 7. | What is the difference between interpolation and extrapolation?
